name: B10-0452/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It condemns Iran's use of the death penalty against protesters and demands a halt to executions. It names two women, Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani, sentenced over the January 2026 protests, and calls for their release. It also asks the European Union to support Iranian civil society, protect Iranians at risk, and hold Iranian officials accountable.

- The Parliament asks Iran to stop executions and release named detainees; nothing changes automatically.
- Iranians at risk could get easier visas and protection from return, if member states agree.
- The Parliament wants more sanctions and support for Iranian civil society; the Commission and Council must decide.
